definitions.explanation: Traditional Japanese garment with wide sleeves and a wraparound design.
General term for clothes (less common usage).

examples.english: It's cold, so put on a thick kimono.

notes:
{着物|きもの} primarily refers to traditional Japanese clothing.

Components: ⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧ (to wear) + ⟦{物|もの}→物：02259_mono⟧ (thing)

Types:
- ⟦{振袖|ふりそで}→振袖：19967_furisode⟧: long-sleeved kimono (for young unmarried women)
- ⟦{浴衣|ゆかた}→浴衣：04081_yukata⟧: summer kimono (casual, for festivals/ryokan)
- ⟦{留袖|とめそで}→留袖：27624_tomesode⟧: formal kimono for married women

Related:
- ⟦{帯|おび}→帯：02610_obi⟧: obi (sash worn with kimono)
- ⟦{和服|わふく}→和服：04094_wafuku⟧: Japanese clothes (more formal term)

Note: Wearing kimono requires special skills; many people hire professionals for special occasions.
